title: TunerZero
summary: Offline instrument tuner for Cardputer Zero.
description:
Tune one string at a time using the Cardputer Zero’s built-in microphone. Chromatic mode shows the nearest note, the measured frequency in Hz and the error in cents. Instrument mode gives you a fixed target for each string or course. Choose from 12 presets for guitar, violin, mandolin, five-string banjo, Irish tenor banjo and Irish bouzouki, including Drop D, DADGAD, Open G and Open D for guitar.

Use the reference tone to tune by ear, and shift it up an octave or two to hear low notes on the small speaker. Adjust A4 from 415 to 466 Hz in 0.1 Hz steps. Your last settings are saved on the device. Audio is processed locally in memory; TunerZero never records, transmits or stores audio.

Developed for Tartanleaf.com by Greg Weir VA1GW
